concern: دیں here is the past-tense verb "gave" (unhon ne ... awaazein diin = "they called out to one another"), romanised "deen", which collides with deen (religion). Owner ruling Q21 / ADR 0005 R6 fixed the identical construction at 45:17 (daleelein din -> daleelein dein) specifically to avoid this collision; this verse still uses the rejected "deen" spelling for the same verb.
suggestion: Ab subah hote hi unhon ne ek doosre ko awaazein dein.
